data.gender_notes: Susann is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew word שָׁשָׁנָה (shoshana) meaning ‘lily’ or ‘grace’. In the Old Testament Book of Daniel, Susanna is a beautiful and virtuous wife who is falsely accused of adultery by two elders. The name Susann carries the meaning “Lily, Grace” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Susann usually hope their child will grow to embody lily, grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Susann total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
